modmenu.descriptionTranslation.renderhid:
Hide blocks and entities in selected regions or adjust their opacity. Filtered types remain visible. World blocks and redstone behavior are unchanged.

H: Settings · F9/F10: Select corners · F7: Save region · F8: Toggle all

Known limitations: Item frames and some touching faces may render incorrectly. Region settings are shared across worlds.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.renderhide: Hide blocks and entities in selected regions or adjust their opacity.
renderhide.changed.title: Changed blocks
renderhide.changed.hint: A new change restarts the timer.
